intent: Small help panel: optional title plus one to three short sentences.
useWhen: Extra explanation beside a Field label or a setting
Copy that is longer than a Tooltip name but not always-visible hint
doNotUseWhen: One-line name on an icon — use Tooltip
Required instructions — keep them in Field hint (always visible)
Links, buttons, or forms — use Modal
Always-visible helper under a control — use Field hint

title.note: Bold header. Omit for body only.

content.note: Plain text. One to three short sentences. No links or markdown.

delay.note: Hover waits; focus and click show at once.

children.note: One focusable trigger. Gets aria-describedby. Typical: kit Button variant=tertiary size=sm iconStart=CircleHelp ariaLabel=Help. Field help composes this.

requirements: Title and content stay in the DOM as the trigger description (aria-describedby) so AT gets them on focus
Hover after delay; focus shows immediately; Enter, Space, click, or tap pins
Escape, click outside, or moving focus away closes
Escape must not close an enclosing Modal
Pointer can move onto the panel to read it
Portal the panel to document.body so Field overflow never clips it

doNot: Do not invent local Popover, HoverCard, InfoTip, ContextInfo, or a one-off ?
Do not use Tooltip for a sentence or two
Do not put help on Input, Textarea, Select, or DatePicker — Field owns it
Do not put links, buttons, or forms in the panel
Do not add size, Density, or lg
Do not use variant=primary on the trigger
Do not add an Icon component or Material Symbols — Lucide via Button/lucideName only
snippet:
<HelpPopover title="Invoice date" content="We use this date on the PDF. It does not change when payment is recorded.">
  <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconStart="CircleHelp" ariaLabel="Help" />
</HelpPopover>
